# jamfplatform_pro_computer_prestage_enrollment (List Resource)

Lists Jamf Pro Computer PreStage Enrollments. Supply an optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched. The Jamf Pro list response carries every attribute, so `include_resource = true` does not require a follow-up read per item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Jamf Software LLC 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

list "jamfplatform_pro_computer_prestage_enrollment" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  filter = {
    name_substring = "standard"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched. For exact-name lookup, use the singular `by name` data source instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
